title: Makita Holders 5-Pack – Your Tools Gathered on the Wall
seo_title: Makita Holders 5-Pack – Tools on the Wall
seo_description: 5 holders in turquoise for the Makita 18V mount. Screwed on through four holes in the plate, gives each tool its own place.
descriptionHtml:
The battery disappears into the toolbox again

The tools and batteries end up in a pile in the box or on the bench, and every job starts with the same searching before you even get going.

5 holders that give each tool its own place

Five holders in turquoise, screwed to the wall through four holes in the plate, fitting tools and batteries with the Makita 18V mount. The tool clicks into place and is visible right away as you walk past.

Features

  • 5 holders in the pack – a place of its own for each tool instead of one shared box
  • The tool is visible right on the wall – you see it without opening a box
  • Fits the Makita 18V mount – tools and batteries click into place
  • Screws on through four holes in the plate – sits firmly on the wall
  • Turquoise color stands out among the tools – easy to see which spot is empty

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
